decisions.reason: The turnaround management software has had a dedicated page since launch and builds directly on the firm's apron and airport equipment knowledge, so the firm can read its early market feedback and keep improving it.
The connectivity module moved from a mention to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment, and it links the firm's own electrical apron equipment to software, a core strength.

Revenue calculation and billing sits further from the firm's electrical engineering base, but its 2024 promotion to its own page suggests the firm has absorbed enough customer knowledge to keep it within its airport suite.
Equipment monitoring draws most directly on the firm's existing knowledge of its own hardware, and its upgrade to a dedicated page in 2024 shows management values it.
